import base64, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/distribution')
expected = '8325a93711826740de4fffb9d43a312b048b26a43212280fd53df55fb5c11eb2'
scanned = []
matches = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not path.is_file() or not any('sqlite' in part.lower() for part in path.parts):
        continue
    if path.suffix.lower() not in {'.zip', '.b64', '.base64', '.txt'} or path.stat().st_size > 65536:
        continue
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    scanned.append(str(path))
    try:
        payload = raw if raw.startswith(b'PK\x03\x04') else base64.b64decode(b''.join(raw.split()), validate=True)
    except ValueError:
        continue
    if hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == expected:
        matches.append(str(path))
result = {'receipt': 'TASK-179579196100', 'expected_sha256': expected, 'matches': matches, 'scanned': scanned}
out = root / 'sqlite-instructor-pilot' / 'exact-preview-archive-location.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'matches': matches, 'files_screened': len(scanned)}))
